pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "The Basic plan is free but limited to 300 minutes per month. Pro is $16.99/user/mo or $8.33/user/mo when billed annually. Business is $30/user/mo or $19.99/user/mo when billed annually."

nl.tagline: Notuleert en transcribeert Zoom-, Teams- en Meet-vergaderingen
nl.description: Otter neemt deel aan online vergaderingen, schrijft live mee en maakt samenvattingen met actiepunten. Je kunt later vragen stellen over wat er besproken is. Sterk in Engelstalige gesprekken.
bestFor: Live meeschrijven tijdens colleges en calls
notFor: Vergaderingen die grotendeels in het Nederlands zijn (controleer de taalondersteuning)

en.tagline: Takes notes and transcribes Zoom, Teams and Meet calls
en.description: Otter joins online meetings, transcribes live and creates summaries with action items. You can ask questions about what was discussed afterwards. Strong for English-language conversations.
bestFor: Live transcription of lectures and calls
notFor: Meetings mostly held in other languages (check language support)
